notes: Positive: prompts asking to break a PRD/tech-spec into an executable development plan, sequence PRs for a migration, define spikes, build a traceability matrix from AC to tasks, plan rollout with feature flags, lay out task dependencies. Negative: write code, write the PRD, write the test plan, write the tech-spec, run sprint planning (capacity allocation), review a PR. Edge: lite-plan requests, plans without an approved spec yet.

cases.query: Break this approved PRD + tech-spec into an executable development plan — ordered tasks, dependencies, PR sequence, spikes, DoD per task
Necesito el plan de desarrollo para el feature de checkout v2 a partir del PRD y la tech-spec aprobados
Turn this epic into a tasks.md — vertically sliced, with explicit dependencies and AC traceability
Plan the rollout for the payments-redesign — which PRs merge first, where do we put feature flags, what's the canary sequence
Build the traceability matrix mapping every acceptance criterion in this PRD to a task with a Definition of Done
Identify the spikes we need before we can commit to the timeline for this migration — give me time-boxes and exit criteria
What's the right sequencing strategy for this schema migration with live readers — expand-contract, flag, or strangler — and lay out the PR order
Decompose this large epic into vertical slices using story mapping; the feature is a multi-step onboarding journey
Plan how we sequence the work for the auth-rewrite — strangler-fig, with rollback at every step
I have the PRD and the architecture decided — give me an implementation plan a developer can pick up tomorrow
Implement the discount-redeem-v2 service end-to-end based on the plan
Write the PRD for the checkout v2 feature
Write the test plan for the payments release
Design the architecture for the new fraud-detection service
Review this PR and tell me what's blocking
Run sprint planning — assign these tasks to engineers based on capacity for the next two weeks
cases.notes: Capacity allocation = engineering manager / scrum master; plan is the *input* to sprint planning.

cases.query: Draft the threat model for the new payment service
Write an ADR for choosing Postgres over DynamoDB
Give me a lite development plan — the PRD is still being finalised but I need a sequencing strategy and spike list
cases.notes: Lite plan is an explicit supported variant when full spec isn't ready.

cases.query: I have a tech-spec but no PRD yet — can you still produce a development plan?
cases.notes: Agent should fire and explicitly flag the missing PRD, not silently refuse.

cases.query: Help me plan the order in which to ship these five features over the next quarter
cases.notes: Cross-feature quarterly sequencing = product / engineering management, not per-feature dev plan.

cases.query: Triagea esto antes de empezar a planear — ¿está listo el spec?

Is this task DV or Enabler? Classify per SAFe and explain
